Water-Driven Sawmill: Placement: Build it at a river or lake, or at any outdoor location watered by a connected Mill Race Outlet. Anywhere else the build is refused. Operation: Drag a log onto the sawmill to Cut it into planks and wood shavings (1.5 hours). Saw All: Load logs into the sawmill's slots, then press Saw All (3 hours) to saw every log at once into 8 planks and 2 wood shavings each. Each log's planks keep its wood and dryness. Saw Blade: Every log sawn, by Cut or Saw All, adds 1 Blade Wear. At 60 the sawmill stops cutting until you drag a Copper Saw Blade onto it (Replace Saw Blade, 30 minutes), which uses the blade up. Saw All saws only as many logs as the blade has left. Packing the sawmill up keeps its wear. Overshot Wheel: Drag an Overshot Wheel onto the sawmill to fit it (30 minutes): Saw All then takes 1.5 hours instead of 3. Pack Up (Overshot) packs the sawmill and gives the wheel back. Expand: Press Expand (30 minutes) to rebuild the sawmill larger in place: its capacity grows from 20000 to 30000 weight, room for 10 logs instead of 6. Everything inside it and any fitted Overshot Wheel are kept. It costs 6 Planks and 4 Iron Nails (Metal Nails of Metal Type 200), taken from your inventory or from cards lying at this location, never from the sawmill's own slots; Expand does nothing until you hold them. Pack Up returns the plain frame, so the expansion is paid for again.
水力锯木厂: 放置： 可在河边、湖边或任何有已连通引水渠出口供水的户外地点建造，其他地方无法建造。 操作： 将原木拖到锯木厂上进行切割（1.5小时），锯成木板和木屑。 全部锯切： 将原木放入锯木厂的格子，再按下全部锯切（3小时），一次把所有原木各锯成8块木板和2份木屑。木板保留各自原木的木材种类和干燥度。 锯条：每锯一根原木（切割或全部锯切）锯条磨损加1。磨损达到60时锯木厂停止锯切，直到你把一把铜锯条拖到锯木厂上（更换锯条，30分钟），这把锯条会被装上消耗掉。全部锯切只会锯锯条剩余寿命所能锯的原木。收起锯木厂会保留磨损。 上射式水车：将上射式水车拖到锯木厂上安装（30分钟）：之后全部锯切由3小时缩短为1.5小时。“收起（上射式水车）”会收起锯木厂并退还水车。 扩建：按下扩建（30分钟），可在原地扩建锯木厂，载重由20000增至30000（可放10根原木而不是6根），里面的物品和已安装的上射式水车都会保留。需要6块木板和4枚铁钉（金属类型200的金属钉），取自你的背包或本地点地面上的卡牌，不会取用锯木厂自身格子里的物品；材料不足时扩建没有任何效果。收起只会得到原来的框架，因此需要重新扩建。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Requirements: Requires local mill race for water power. Water-powered actions stop while a frozen Mill Race Outlet is the only water. The Winter Station Lock setting (on by default since 1.12.10) also stops them at every location in winter. Heat at the location keeps them running: a lit Campfire, Fire Pit, Fireplace, Oven, Kiln, Furnace, Bloomery or Forge, a lit Copper Brazier (Advanced Copper Tools), or a Water-Driven Forge or Workshop at least half hot. Operation: Drag firewood or charcoal onto the forge to feed fuel, then light it with embers. The forge naturally heats to about 1000. In a windy highland environment, natural wind gradually raises the forge to smelting temperature (1100) on its own. Use Blast when water is flowing, or drag Bellows onto the lit forge by hand, to quickly reach smelting temperature. You can also place metal nuggets and clay items in the inventory.
水力锯木厂: 需求： 需要本地引水渠提供水力。当唯一的水源是结冰的引水渠出口时，水力动作会停止。设置“Winter Station Lock”（冬季站点锁定，自1.12.10起默认开启）还会在冬季使所有地点的水力动作停止。该地点有热源即可使其继续运转：点燃的营火、火坑、壁炉、烤箱、窑炉、熔炉、块炼炉或锻造台，点燃的铜制火盆（Advanced Copper Tools），或温度至少过半的水力锻炉或水力工坊。 操作： 将柴火或木炭拖至锻炉补充燃料，然后用余烬点燃。锻炉会自然升温至约1000度。在多风的高地环境中，自然风会逐渐将锻炉升温至冶炼温度（1100度）。水流流动时可使用鼓风，或手动将风箱拖至已点燃的锻炉上，以快速达到冶炼温度。也可在库存中放入金属块和陶土物品。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Fill containers: Drag an empty water container onto the outlet to draw unclean water. Rain Cistern: A Rain Cistern built in the same location slowly fills with river water, about 22 days from empty to full, so water banked in summer and autumn lasts into winter. Each outlet in the location adds its own flow. A cistern already holding a different liquid, such as rainwater, is left alone until it is drawn empty. Winter: The outlet freezes in winter: no water can be drawn and the cistern stops filling until the spring thaw. Close Valve: Shut the water off without packing the outlet up (15 minutes): nothing can be drawn, the cistern stops filling and the stations that run on this outlet stop until you open the valve again. Pack Up: Recover the mill race outlet as a portable item for relocation.
水力锯木厂: 取水：将空水容器拖到出口上以汲取不洁水。 雨水窖：建在同一地点的雨水窖会被缓慢注入河水，从空到满约需22天，因此夏秋两季蓄下的水可以留到冬季使用。同一地点的每个出口都会各自注水。已装有其他液体（例如雨水）的雨水窖不会被注水，直到其中的液体被取空。 冬季：冬季出口结冰：春天解冻前无法取水，雨水窖也不再注水。 关闭水闸：无需收起出口即可断水（15分钟）：在重新打开水闸之前无法取水，雨水窖停止注水，依靠此出口运转的工作站也会停止。 收起：将水道出口收回为可搬运物品以便重新安置。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Frozen: No water can be drawn during winter. Chip Ice: Chip blocks of ice from the frozen race — store them in an Ice Pit or let them melt for water. Heat: Heat in this location keeps the machinery running, even while the outlet is frozen: a lit Campfire, Fire Pit, Fireplace, Oven, Kiln, Furnace, Bloomery or Forge, a lit Copper Brazier (Advanced Copper Tools), or a Water-Driven Forge or Workshop at least half hot. Heat does not thaw the outlet, so a Rain Cistern here stays unfed until spring. Spring thaw: The outlet automatically resumes when winter ends. Pack Up: Recover the outlet as a portable item for relocation even when frozen.
水力锯木厂: 已结冰：冬季无法取水。 凿冰：可从冰冻的水渠上凿下冰块——存入冰窖或融化取水。 热源：即使出水口结冰，该地点的热源也能让机械继续运转：点燃的营火、火坑、壁炉、烤箱、窑炉、熔炉、块炼炉或锻造台，点燃的铜制火盆（Advanced Copper Tools），或温度至少过半的水力锻炉或水力工坊。热源不会让出口解冻，因此这里的雨水窖要到春天才会重新注水。 春季解冻：冬季结束时出口自动恢复。 收起：即使结冰也可收回为可搬运物品以便重新安置。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Requirements: Requires mill race access for water power. Water-powered actions stop while a frozen Mill Race Outlet is the only water. The Winter Station Lock setting (on by default since 1.12.10) also stops them at every location in winter. Heat at the location keeps them running: a lit Campfire, Fire Pit, Fireplace, Oven, Kiln, Furnace, Bloomery or Forge, a lit Copper Brazier (Advanced Copper Tools), or a Water-Driven Forge or Workshop at least half hot. Operation: Drag firewood or charcoal onto the workshop forge to feed fuel, then light it with embers. The forge naturally heats to about 1000. In a windy highland environment, natural wind gradually raises the forge to smelting temperature (1100) on its own, so no Blast is needed. Use Blast when water is flowing, or drag Bellows onto the lit forge by hand, to quickly reach smelting temperature. Place heated metal tool blanks or copper parts in the inventory, then press Hammer All to apply one water-hammer strike to each item while water is flowing. Each press also raises the item's Metal Quality and Quality by 2, up to 60; above that only your own Smith strikes raise it (this doesn't show as a visible number on the item itself, but it carries over once the item is finished or transformed). Put six copper nuggets in the workshop inventory, then use Hammer Copper Sheet or Forge Copper Nails to produce output. Six iron-grade nuggets (Metal Type 200, from the Ore Sluice or from smelting iron items) work the same way with Forge Iron Nails or Hammer Iron Sheet, and each craft takes only nuggets of its own grade. Results appear on the ground beside the workshop. Accepts: All heated tool blanks, heated lump of metal, copper gear parts, and any item tagged Heatable or Copper. Overshot Wheel: Drag an Overshot Wheel onto the workshop to fit it (30 minutes): Hammer All then takes 15 minutes instead of 30; Blast and the crafts are unchanged. Pack Up (Overshot) packs the workshop and gives the wheel back. Expand: Press Expand (30 minutes) to rebuild the workshop larger in place: its capacity grows from 5000 to 7000 weight. Everything inside it, its temperature and any fitted Overshot Wheel are kept. It costs 6 Planks and 4 Iron Nails (Metal Nails of Metal Type 200), taken from your inventory or from cards lying at this location, never from the workshop's own slots; Expand does nothing until you hold them. Pack Up returns the plain kit, so the expansion is paid for again.
水力锯木厂: 需求：需要水道提供水力。当唯一的水源是结冰的引水渠出口时，水力动作会停止。设置“Winter Station Lock”（冬季站点锁定，自1.12.10起默认开启）还会在冬季使所有地点的水力动作停止。该地点有热源即可使其继续运转：点燃的营火、火坑、壁炉、烤箱、窑炉、熔炉、块炼炉或锻造台，点燃的铜制火盆（Advanced Copper Tools），或温度至少过半的水力锻炉或水力工坊。 操作方法：将木柴或木炭拖到作坊锻炉上加燃料。用余烬点火，在有风的高地环境中，自然风力会自动将锻炉升温至冶炼温度（1100），无需鼓风。水流畅通时按“鼓风”升温，或手动将风箱拖到点燃的锻炉上快速达到冶炼温度。将加热的金属工具坯料或铜零件放入库存，然后按“全部锤打”对每件物品施加一次水锤击，每次按下还会使物品的金属品质和品质提升2点，最高到60，超过60只能靠你亲手锻打提升（该数值不会以可见数字显示在物品上，但会在物品完成或转变时保留下来）。将六块铜块放入工坊库存，使用锤打铜片或锻造铜钉生产产品。六块铁级金属块（金属类型200，来自矿石淘洗槽或冶炼铁制物品）同样适用，使用锻造铁钉或锤打铁板，且每种制作只消耗对应等级的金属块。产出物品出现在工坊旁边的地面上。 接受：所有加热的工具坯料、加热金属块、铜齿轮零件，以及任何标记为可加热或铜质的物品。 上射式水车：将上射式水车拖到工坊上安装（30分钟）：之后全部锤打由30分钟缩短为15分钟；鼓风和各项制作不变。“收起（上射式水车）”会收起工坊并退还水车。 扩建：按下扩建（30分钟），可在原地扩建工坊，载重由5000增至7000，里面的物品、温度和已安装的上射式水车都会保留。需要6块木板和4枚铁钉（金属类型200的金属钉），取自你的背包或本地点地面上的卡牌，不会取用工坊自身格子里的物品；材料不足时扩建没有任何效果。收起只会得到原来的套件，因此需要重新扩建。

It crushes greenstone, greenstone slag and bog iron a batch at a time.

水力锯木厂: 用小型熔融锡、锡青铜或白青铜坩埚在泥砖和黏土模具中铸造小青铜齿轮，然后用锤子敲开。

水力锯木厂: 需要小型熔融青铜坩埚

水力锯木厂: 用途: 水驱机械部件。可代替小铜齿轮用于水车、上射式水车及其他水驱配方。需要先进铜工具模组才能铸造。 用于: 锯木厂、工坊及其他水力装置。

Water-Driven Sawmill: A water-powered sawmill rebuilt larger in place: it holds 30000 weight instead of 20000, room for ten logs instead of six.
水力锯木厂: 在原地扩建的水力锯木厂：载重由20000增至30000，可容纳十根原木而不是六根。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Expanded: This sawmill was rebuilt larger in place and holds 30000 weight instead of 20000, room for 10 logs instead of 6. It works exactly like the standard sawmill. Pack Up returns the plain frame, so a rebuilt sawmill must be expanded again. Placement: Build it at a river or lake, or at any outdoor location watered by a connected Mill Race Outlet. Anywhere else the build is refused. Operation: Drag a log onto the sawmill to Cut it into planks and wood shavings (1.5 hours). Saw All: Load logs into the sawmill's slots, then press Saw All (3 hours) to saw every log at once into 8 planks and 2 wood shavings each. Each log's planks keep its wood and dryness. Saw Blade: Every log sawn, by Cut or Saw All, adds 1 Blade Wear. At 60 the sawmill stops cutting until you drag a Copper Saw Blade onto it (Replace Saw Blade, 30 minutes), which uses the blade up. Saw All saws only as many logs as the blade has left. Packing the sawmill up keeps its wear. Overshot Wheel: Drag an Overshot Wheel onto the sawmill to fit it (30 minutes): Saw All then takes 1.5 hours instead of 3. Pack Up (Overshot) packs the sawmill and gives the wheel back.
水力锯木厂: 已扩建：这座锯木厂已在原地扩建，载重由20000增至30000，可放10根原木而不是6根，用法与普通锯木厂完全相同。收起只会得到原来的框架，重建后需要重新扩建。 放置： 可在河边、湖边或任何有已连通引水渠出口供水的户外地点建造，其他地方无法建造。 操作： 将原木拖到锯木厂上进行切割（1.5小时），锯成木板和木屑。 全部锯切： 将原木放入锯木厂的格子，再按下全部锯切（3小时），一次把所有原木各锯成8块木板和2份木屑。木板保留各自原木的木材种类和干燥度。 锯条：每锯一根原木（切割或全部锯切）锯条磨损加1。磨损达到60时锯木厂停止锯切，直到你把一把铜锯条拖到锯木厂上（更换锯条，30分钟），这把锯条会被装上消耗掉。全部锯切只会锯锯条剩余寿命所能锯的原木。收起锯木厂会保留磨损。 上射式水车：将上射式水车拖到锯木厂上安装（30分钟）：之后全部锯切由3小时缩短为1.5小时。“收起（上射式水车）”会收起锯木厂并退还水车。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Rebuild this sawmill larger in place: capacity grows to 30000 weight (10 logs instead of 6). Costs 6 Planks and 4 Iron Nails (Metal Nails of Metal Type 200) from your inventory or this location, never from the sawmill's own slots.
水力锯木厂: 在原地扩建锯木厂，载重增至30000（可放10根原木而不是6根）。需要6块木板和4枚铁钉（金属类型200的金属钉），取自你的背包或本地点，不会取用锯木厂自身格子里的物品。

Water-Driven Sawmill: A water-powered metalworking workshop rebuilt larger in place: it holds 7000 weight instead of 5000.
水力锯木厂: 在原地扩建的水力金属加工工坊：载重由5000增至7000。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Expanded: This workshop was rebuilt larger in place and holds 7000 weight instead of 5000. It works exactly like the standard workshop. Pack Up returns the plain kit, so a rebuilt workshop must be expanded again. Requirements: Requires mill race access for water power. Water-powered actions stop while a frozen Mill Race Outlet is the only water. The Winter Station Lock setting (on by default since 1.12.10) also stops them at every location in winter. Heat at the location keeps them running: a lit Campfire, Fire Pit, Fireplace, Oven, Kiln, Furnace, Bloomery or Forge, a lit Copper Brazier (Advanced Copper Tools), or a Water-Driven Forge or Workshop at least half hot. Operation: Drag firewood or charcoal onto the workshop forge to feed fuel, then light it with embers. The forge naturally heats to about 1000. In a windy highland environment, natural wind gradually raises the forge to smelting temperature (1100) on its own, so no Blast is needed. Use Blast when water is flowing, or drag Bellows onto the lit forge by hand, to quickly reach smelting temperature. Place heated metal tool blanks or copper parts in the inventory, then press Hammer All to apply one water-hammer strike to each item while water is flowing. Each press also raises the item's Metal Quality and Quality by 2, up to 60; above that only your own Smith strikes raise it (this doesn't show as a visible number on the item itself, but it carries over once the item is finished or transformed). Put six copper nuggets in the workshop inventory, then use Hammer Copper Sheet or Forge Copper Nails to produce output. Six iron-grade nuggets (Metal Type 200, from the Ore Sluice or from smelting iron items) work the same way with Forge Iron Nails or Hammer Iron Sheet, and each craft takes only nuggets of its own grade. Results appear on the ground beside the workshop. Accepts: All heated tool blanks, heated lump of metal, copper gear parts, and any item tagged Heatable or Copper. Overshot Wheel: Drag an Overshot Wheel onto the workshop to fit it (30 minutes): Hammer All then takes 15 minutes instead of 30; Blast and the crafts are unchanged. Pack Up (Overshot) packs the workshop and gives the wheel back.
水力锯木厂: 已扩建：这座工坊已在原地扩建，载重由5000增至7000，用法与普通工坊完全相同。收起只会得到原来的套件，重建后需要重新扩建。 需求： 需要引水渠提供水力。当唯一的水源是结冰的引水渠出口时，水力动作会停止。设置“Winter Station Lock”（冬季站点锁定，自1.12.10起默认开启）还会在冬季使所有地点的水力动作停止。该地点有热源即可使其继续运转：点燃的营火、火坑、壁炉、烤箱、窑炉、熔炉、块炼炉或锻造台，点燃的铜制火盆（Advanced Copper Tools），或温度至少过半的水力锻炉或水力工坊。 操作： 将柴火或木炭拖至工坊锻炉补充燃料，然后用余烬点火。锻炉会自然升温至约1000。在有风的高地环境中，自然风力会自动将锻炉升温至冶炼温度（1100），无需鼓风。水流畅通时可使用鼓风，或手动将风箱拖到已点燃的锻炉上快速达到冶炼温度。将加热的金属工具坯料或铜零件放入库存，然后在水流畅通时按全部锤打，每次按下还会使物品的金属品质和品质提升2点，最高到60，超过60只能靠你亲手锻打提升。将六块铜块放入工坊库存，使用锤打铜片或锻造铜钉生产产品。六块铁级金属块（金属类型200，来自矿石淘洗槽或冶炼铁制物品）同样适用，使用锻造铁钉或锤打铁板，且每种制作只消耗对应等级的金属块。产出物品出现在工坊旁边的地面上。 接受： 所有加热工具坯料、加热金属块、铜齿轮零件，以及任何带有可加热或铜标签的物品。 上射式水车：将上射式水车拖到工坊上安装（30分钟）：之后全部锤打由30分钟缩短为15分钟；鼓风和各项制作不变。“收起（上射式水车）”会收起工坊并退还水车。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Rebuild this workshop larger in place: capacity grows from 5000 to 7000 weight. Costs 6 Planks and 4 Iron Nails (Metal Nails of Metal Type 200) from your inventory or this location, never from the workshop's own slots.
水力锯木厂: 在原地扩建工坊，载重由5000增至7000。需要6块木板和4枚铁钉（金属类型200的金属钉），取自你的背包或本地点，不会取用工坊自身格子里的物品。

Water-Driven Sawmill: An old card becomes a Copper Sheet (a Metal Sheet of copper, Metal Type 100).
水力锯木厂: 旧卡牌变为一块铜片（铜质金属片，金属类型100）。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Turn this old Cast Copper Sheet into a Copper Sheet (a Metal Sheet of copper, Metal Type 100), the card every WDI recipe now takes.
水力锯木厂: 把这张旧铸造铜板变成一块铜片（铜质金属片，金属类型100），现在所有水力基础设施配方都使用这张卡。

Water-Driven Sawmill: An old card becomes an Iron Sheet (a Metal Sheet of iron, Metal Type 200).

水力锯木厂: 把这张旧铸造铁板变成一块铁片（铁质金属片，金属类型200），现在所有水力基础设施配方都使用这张卡。

Water-Driven Sawmill: An old card becomes Tin Solder.
Turn this old Alloy Solder into Tin Solder, the card every WDI recipe now takes.
水力锯木厂: 把这张旧合金焊条变成锡焊料，现在所有水力基础设施配方都使用这张卡。

Water-Driven Sawmill: An old card becomes a Copper Nail (a Metal Nail of copper, Metal Type 100).

Water-Driven Sawmill: Turn this old Cast Copper Rivet into a Copper Nail (a Metal Nail of copper, Metal Type 100), the card every WDI recipe now takes.
水力锯木厂: 把这张旧铸造铜铆钉变成一枚铜钉（铜质金属钉，金属类型100），现在所有水力基础设施配方都使用这张卡。

Water-Driven Sawmill: An old card becomes an Iron Nail (a Metal Nail of iron, Metal Type 200).

Water-Driven Sawmill: Turn this old Cast Iron Rivet into an Iron Nail (a Metal Nail of iron, Metal Type 200), the card every WDI recipe now takes.
水力锯木厂: 把这张旧铸造铁铆钉变成一枚铁钉（铁质金属钉，金属类型200），现在所有水力基础设施配方都使用这张卡。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Assemble a water-driven fulling mill: trip hammers worked off a water mill that beat finished cloth to raise its quality. Requires a water mill as the core drive.
水力锯木厂: 组装水力缩绒坊：由水力磨坊驱动的落锤反复捸打成品布料以提升其品质。需要水力磨坊作为核心驱动。

Water-Driven Sawmill: A complete fulling mill kit: a water mill drive, trip-hammer stocks and a trough for beating finished cloth.
水力锯木厂: 完整的缩绒坊套件：水力磨坊驱动、落锤架和用于捸打成品布料的水槽。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Use: Place near water or a connected mill race outlet to set up the fulling mill. Scale: A water-powered construction: it needs water power and a water mill as its drive.
水力锯木厂: 用途：放置在水源旁或引水渠出口附近以搭建缩绒坊。 规模：水力建造：需要水力以及作为驱动的水力磨坊。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Place the fulling mill kit into the environment.
水力锯木厂: 将缩绒坊套件放置在环境中。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Break down the kit: the water mill and iron parts come back whole, bulk materials at half.
水力锯木厂: 拆解套件：水力磨坊和铁零件全数返还，大宗材料返还一半。

Water-Driven Sawmill: A water-powered fulling mill whose trip hammers beat finished cloth to raise its quality.
水力锯木厂: 以落锤捸打成品布料提升品质的水力缩绒坊。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Requirements: Requires a local mill race for water power. Operation: Load finished cloth (Small, Medium or Large Cloth), then press Full All to beat the whole batch and raise each piece's Quality by a step. Time: Full All takes 1.5 hours. Limit: Fulling brings cloth up to a fair finish only; the last of a piece's quality still comes from better fibre at the loom.
水力锯木厂: 要求：需要本地引水渠提供水力。 操作：装入成品布料（小、中或大块布），然后按下全部缩绒以捸打整批布料，使每块布料的品质提升一档。 耗时：全部缩绒耗时1.5小时。 限制：缩绒只能将布料提升至中等水准；布料最后的品质仍需在织机上使用更优质的纤维获得。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Engage the trip hammers and beat every loaded piece of cloth, raising its Quality by a step.
水力锯木厂: 启动落锤，捸打所有装载的布料，使其品质提升一档。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Pack up the fulling mill back into a transportable kit.
水力锯木厂: 将缩绒坊收回为可携带套件。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Make a retting pit kit from 6 Stone, 4 Planks and 2 Rope (1 hour) at a river or lake, or at any outdoor location watered by a connected Mill Race Outlet, and place it there. Flax stems, nettle stems and reeds soak in it exactly as they do in a river, so you can ret them at your base.
水力锯木厂: 用6块石头、4块木板和2根绳子制作沤麻池套件（1小时），可在河边、湖边或任何有已连通引水渠出口供水的户外地点制作并放置。亚麻茎、荨麻茎和芦苇在池中浸泡的效果与在河中完全相同，让你在营地就能沤麻。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Lining stones, plank edging and rope ties for a small retting pit, ready to set where running water can fill it.
水力锯木厂: 用于搭建小型沤麻池的衬底石块、木板围边和绳结，可放在流水能灌满它的地方。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Use: Place at a river or lake, or at any outdoor location watered by a connected Mill Race Outlet, to set up the retting pit. Anywhere else the placement is refused. Disassemble: Recover half of the stone and planks and one rope.
水力锯木厂: 用途：放置在河边、湖边，或任何有已连通引水渠出口供水的户外地点，即可搭建沤麻池。在其他地方放置会被拒绝。 拆卸：回收一半的石头和木板以及一根绳子。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Set the retting pit into the ground where running water can fill it.
水力锯木厂: 把沤麻池安置在流水能灌满它的地面上。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Break down the kit and recover half of the stone and planks and one rope.
水力锯木厂: 拆解套件，回收一半的石头和木板以及一根绳子。

Water-Driven Sawmill: A stone-lined pit kept full by running water. Flax, nettle and reeds soak in it just as they would in a river.
水力锯木厂: 一个由流水保持满水的石砌浅池。亚麻、荨麻和芦苇在其中浸泡，就和在河里一样。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Placement: Build it at a river or lake, or at any outdoor location watered by a connected Mill Race Outlet. Anywhere else the build is refused. The pit takes no stems while that water is cut off (a closed or missing outlet, or a frozen one with no fire beside it). Soaking: Drag Flax Stems, Nettle Stems or Fresh Reeds onto the pit. They become the same Soaking cards a river makes and gain quality exactly as they would in a river: no faster, and to the same limits (flax 40, reeds 50, nettle 30). Pick them up when they are ready. Nothing else can be soaked here. Pack Up: Packs the pit back into its kit.
水力锯木厂: 放置：建在河边、湖边，或任何有已连通引水渠出口供水的户外地点。在其他地方建造会被拒绝。水源被切断时（出口关闭或不存在，或出口结冰且旁边没有火），池子不接受任何茎秆。 浸泡：把亚麻茎、荨麻茎或青芦苇拖到池上。它们会变成与河中相同的泡水卡牌，并以与河中完全相同的方式提升品质：不会更快，上限也相同（亚麻40、芦苇50、荨麻30）。泡好后将其拾起。这里不能浸泡其他东西。 收起：把沤麻池收回为套件。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Lay the nettle stems in the pit to soak, as you would in a river.
水力锯木厂: 把荨麻茎放进池中浸泡，就像在河里一样。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Lay the flax stems in the pit to soak, as you would in a river.
水力锯木厂: 把亚麻茎放进池中浸泡，就像在河里一样。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Lay the reeds in the pit to soak, as you would in a river.
水力锯木厂: 把芦苇放进池中浸泡，就像在河里一样。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Pack the retting pit back into a transportable kit.
水力锯木厂: 把沤麻池收回为可携带的套件。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Make an irrigation channel kit from 4 Stone and 4 Planks (1 hour) at a river or lake, or at any outdoor location watered by a connected Mill Race Outlet, and place it there. While a flowing outlet stands at the same location it keeps Flax, Wheat, Pea and Turnroot fields there out of drought. It never makes a crop grow faster.
水力锯木厂: 用4块石头和4块木板制作灌溉沟渠套件（1小时），可在河边、湖边或任何有已连通引水渠出口供水的户外地点制作并放置。只要同一地点立着一个流动的引水渠出口，它就能让那里的亚麻、小麦、豌豆和翻根田免受干旱。它绝不会让作物长得更快。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Stone-lined plank troughs and sluice boards for a small field channel, ready to lay from a mill race outlet to the fields.
水力锯木厂: 用石块衬底的木板水槽和闸板，可搭成一条小田沟，从引水渠出口一直铺到田边。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Use: Place at a river or lake, or at any outdoor location watered by a connected Mill Race Outlet, to lay the channel. Anywhere else the placement is refused. One channel per location: Place is hidden while one already stands there. Disassemble: Recover half of the stone and planks.
水力锯木厂: 用途：在河边、湖边或任何有已连通引水渠出口供水的户外地点放置，即可铺设沟渠。在其他地方放置会被拒绝。每个地点只能有一条沟渠：已有一条时“放置”会被隐藏。 拆卸：回收一半的石头和木板。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Lay the channel from the mill race outlet to the fields here.
水力锯木厂: 在这里把沟渠从引水渠出口铺到田边。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Break down the kit and recover half of the stone and planks.
水力锯木厂: 拆解套件，回收一半的石头和木板。

Water-Driven Sawmill: A plank-lined channel that leads water from the mill race outlet along the field edges, so a dry spell cannot parch the crops here.
水力锯木厂: 一条木板衬边的沟渠，把引水渠出口的水沿着田边引过来，干旱的日子也晒不干这里的庄稼。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Drought only: While a flowing Mill Race Outlet stands at this location, every Flax, Wheat, Pea and Turnroot field here gains 20 Hydration a tick. That is enough to lift a field out of drought (below 1920 Hydration, where it loses Health) but never enough to raise one that is already well watered: above 1920 the field dries faster than the channel adds. It changes nothing else: no faster growth, no bigger harvest. When it stops: A closed or frozen outlet, or no outlet at this location, feeds nothing, even beside a fire. A field on a river shore or in wetlands already draws that water from the ground, so the channel leaves it alone. Other crops (garden plots, other mods' plants) are not watered. Pack Up: Packs the channel back into its kit.
水力锯木厂: 只防干旱：只要这个地点立着一个流动的引水渠出口，这里的每块亚麻、小麦、豌豆和翻根田每刻获得20点湿度。这足以让田地脱离干旱（湿度低于1920时田地会损失健康度），但绝不会让已经浇足水的田地更湿：湿度高于1920时，田地蒸发得比沟渠补水更快。除此之外它什么都不改变：不会长得更快，也不会多收。 何时停止：引水渠出口关闭或结冰，或这个地点没有出口时，沟渠不供水，旁边生着火也一样。河岸或湿地上的田已经从地下得到这些水，所以沟渠不会管它们。其他作物（菜园地块、其他模组的植物）不会被浇灌。 收起：把沟渠收回为套件。

Water-Driven Sawmill: Pack the irrigation channel back into a transportable kit.
水力锯木厂: 把灌溉沟渠收回为可携带的套件。
